segments.snp5.17:1.3: Nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu;
segments.snp5.17:3.1: “Disā catasso vidisā catasso, uddhaṃ adho dasa disā imāyo;
segments.snp5.17:3.3: Na tuyhaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ asutaṃ amutaṃ [asutaṃ amutaṃ vā (sī.), asutāmutaṃ vā (syā.), asutaṃ’ mutaṃ vā (pī.)], atho aviññātaṃ kiñcanamatthi [kiñci matthi (syā.), kiñci natthi (pī.), kiñcinamatthi (ka.)] loke;
segments.snp5.17:3.5: Ācikkha dhammaṃ yamahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ”.
segments.snp5.17:4.4: Tasmā tuvaṃ piṅgiya appamatto, jahassu taṇhaṃ apunabbhavāyā”ti.

lines: 1129-30. Evaṃ bhagavatā yāva arahattaṃ tāva kathitaṃ paṭipattiṃ sutvāpi piṅgiyo jarādubbalatāya visesaṃ anadhigantvāva puna “disā catasso”ti imāya gāthāya bhagavantaṃ thomento desanaṃ yācati.
Athassa bhagavā punapi yāva arahattaṃ, tāva paṭipadaṃ dassento “taṇhādhipanne”ti gāthamāha.
